fields.description: Issue includes political commentary and election coverage focused on Florida and Dade County races, including an editorial urging support for Governor John W. Martin for U.S. Senate over Park Trammell and extensive discussion of the Dade County sheriff campaign (including references to candidates and campaign activity). Also contains local columns and briefs, civic and public-safety commentary (causeway/Biscayne Boulevard traffic hazards), notices and paid political advertisements, business and banking content including a letter to depositors of The Southern Bank & Trust Company, and community/entertainment items such as a juvenile movie impersonation contest at the Roney Plaza (Miami Beach), sports/boxing promotions at Miami Coliseum, and travel/steamship advertising.
